subject.title: feat(android): add safe cron job management

question: Should maintainers proceed with this maintainer-labeled Android cron management replacement once exact-head Android validation is clean, or require additional API 36/live-device proof first?
rationale: The PR intentionally supersedes an older contributor branch and adds admin-scoped Android mutation controls, so cleanup automation should not decide the final landing standard for maintainers.

options.title: Proceed After Clean Exact-Head Validation
options.body: Treat this PR as the canonical replacement and land it after Android CI/Testbox proof is clean or the Gradle timeout is rerun cleanly.

options.title: Require Additional Live Proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until API 36 or live-device proof demonstrates the cron management UI against a real gateway.

options.title: Pause And Narrow
options.body: Pause this PR and ask for a smaller follow-up only if maintainers want less Android cron-management scope in one change.

recommendation.title: Proceed After Clean Exact-Head Validation
recommendation.body: Treat this PR as the canonical replacement and land it after Android CI/Testbox proof is clean or the Gradle timeout is rerun cleanly.
